scope: Six bounded CPU estimators and two saved-model prediction operations. This is partial JMP 19.2 method coverage, not family equivalence.
integration_status: Actual public execute15tests and production exported C ABI4369checks pass. SQL registration fragment tasks/jmp-latent-registry.inc is ready; loaded native DuckDB SQL verification remains pending parent integration/build.

common_contract.result: JSON object with version 1; Rust Result error for unsupported/invalid/nonfinite/unidentified conditions; SQL NULL behavior belongs to existing parent adapter.
common_contract.data_limits: Finite nonempty rectangular matrix, <=10000 rows, <=128 columns, <=1000000 cells; per-method limits are tighter. <=16384 finite argument doubles.
common_contract.work_limit: Nominal bounded numerical work guard 200000000 units; individual eigensolver/SVD guards also apply. Large valid-shaped problems may be rejected before iteration.
common_contract.stable_predictions: Feature centering is represented as first-row origin plus a separate mean offset. Saved models retain this representation; rounded display component means/codebooks should not be substituted into portable parameters.
common_contract.portable_limit: Training rejects models whose portable vector would exceed 16384 parameters; GMM length 2+3p+k+kp+kp^2, SOM length 2+3p+kp.
common_contract.convergence: Finite iteration limits return converged:false when an admissible iterate exists; degeneracy, invalid domains and nonfinite arithmetic return errors. No unspecified convergence success is implied.
common_contract.input_training: Each unsupervised fit uses all supplied rows. Saved prediction methods and factor/CCA glm_predict scoring reuse fit-time preprocessing without query-driven centering/scaling.
common_contract.axis_conventions: Signs or bases of tied/null axes are not identifiable; compare distances, common covariance or subspaces rather than signs.

operations.data: Either feature rows (2..128 observations, 1..64 features), or a square 2..128 dissimilarity matrix.
args: standardize: 0 none (default), 1 population feature standard deviation; only for feature input
operations.estimator: Classical metric MDS: eigendecomposition of the double-centered squared-distance Gower matrix. Positive eigenvalues are retained; missing requested positive axes are zero. Distance input must be symmetric, nonnegative and have zero diagonal.
operations.prediction: No saved model or supplementary-point projection. All supplied observations are embedded jointly.
operations.known_value: eigenvalues [2,0,0]; pairwise distances 1,1,2; stress approximately zero

operations.data: Nonnegative contingency table with 2..64 rows and 2..64 columns; every row and column margin must be positive.
args: scaling: 0 principal (default), 1 symmetric square-root singular-value scaling
operations.estimator: SVD of Dr^-1/2 (P-r*cT) Dc^-1/2, where P is table/total frequency. Principal row/column coordinates multiply singular vectors by singular values and divide by square-root masses; symmetric coordinates use square-root singular values.
operations.prediction: No supplementary categories or new-row projection. Empty categories must be removed explicitly.

operations.data: Numeric feature rows with >=2 observations and 2..64 variables, or a symmetric positive-definite correlation matrix with diagonal 1.
args: maxiter: integer 1..2000, default 200; each principal-axis and varimax phase has this limit
input: 0 raw feature rows (default), 1 correlation matrix
operations.estimator: Iterated principal-axis factoring replaces correlation diagonal with communalities and retains largest requested positive common-variance eigenvalues; SMC starts 1-1/diag(R^-1). Varimax uses cyclic analytic pair rotations after row communality normalization. Heywood cases are rejected.
operations.prediction: Regression scores use standardized X * R^-1 * loadings. Each axis in score_predict_parameters is passed unchanged to chem_glm_predict. Raw input saves population centering/scales; correlation input produces no training scores and requires standardized variables when reusing the saved scoring vectors.
operations.known_value: one common factor: loadings .8, communalities .64, uniquenesses .36, score weights .8/2.28

operations.data: Numeric rows [X variables...,Y variables...], >=3 observations, <=32 variables per block and <=64 total.
args: ridge: nonnegative diagonal regularization in population-standardized feature/sample-covariance units, default 0
operations.estimator: Center and population-standardize each block, compute sample covariance with denominator n-1, add ridge to both diagonal blocks, and take SVD of inverse-square-root-whitened cross covariance. Scores have unit regularized sample-covariance variance. With ridge, canonical singular values and actual score correlations differ and are returned separately.
operations.prediction: Pass each axis scoring vector unchanged to chem_glm_predict on its corresponding original-unit X or Y feature block. Numeric null canonical dimensions are completed orthonormally. Unregularized singular within-block covariance is rejected; constant score directions are rejected if actual correlation is undefined.
operations.known_value: one canonical correlation 1; both score sample variances 1

operations.data: Numeric feature rows, >=2 observations, <=32 features. All supplied rows train the model.
args: tolerance: 1e-12..1e-2, default 1e-6; relative observed log-likelihood change
covariance_floor: nonnegative minimum covariance eigenvalue in population-standardized units, default 1e-6
seed: exact integer 0..2^53-1, default 0; SplitMix64 deterministic starts
operations.estimator: Full-covariance Gaussian mixture EM with seeded kmeans++ mean initialization, global initial covariance, exact eigenvalue-constrained covariance M step and log-sum-exp responsibilities. The best observed-likelihood valid start is returned. Component order is lexicographic standardized means. This covariance constraint is not an additive diagonal ridge.
outputs: component_covariances_flat (one row-major p*p row per component, original units)
operations.prediction: Use gaussian_mixture_predict with unchanged predict_parameters. Portable layout: [p,k,feature_origins(p),feature_mean_offsets(p),feature_scales(p),weights(k),standardized_means(k*p),standardized_covariances(k*p*p)]. Density includes the centering/scaling Jacobian.
operations.known_value: single component mean 0, variance 2/3, probabilities all 1

operations.data: Numeric new feature rows with same width as saved model; 1..10000 rows.
args: Unchanged predict_parameters returned by gaussian_mixture; <=16384 finite doubles. Header, scales, weights, symmetry and positive-definite covariance are checked.
operations.estimator: Saved full-covariance component density evaluation with log-sum-exp normalization. No re-centering or refitting on query rows.
outputs: labels (zero-based; lowest index wins exact ties)
operations.prediction: Models use explicit origin plus mean-offset representation, retaining feature spreads near large origins.
operations.known_value: saved N(0,1) model: log density at 0 is -.5*ln(2*pi)

operations.data: Numeric feature rows, >=2 observations, <=64 features. All supplied rows train the model.
args: bandwidth: positive Gaussian kernel bandwidth in normalized [-1,1] grid coordinates, default .5
standardize: 0 none, 1 population feature standard deviation (default)
tolerance: 1e-12..1e-2, default 1e-6; maximum codebook displacement relative to previous largest norm
operations.estimator: Rectangular PCA grid initialization spanning +/-2.5 population principal-component SDs. Batch nearest-node assignments are smoothed by cluster-size-weighted Gaussian-kernel local linear regressions on active normalized grid axes. Singular local regression falls back explicitly to local weighted mean, counted in metadata. Bandwidth stays fixed.
outputs: quantization_error (mean Euclidean nearest-node distance in fit-preprocessed feature units)
topographic_error (fraction whose best and second-best nodes are not four-neighbor adjacent)
operations.prediction: Use som_predict with unchanged predict_parameters. Portable layout: [p,k,feature_origins(p),feature_mean_offsets(p),feature_scales(p),preprocessed_codebook(k*p)]. Grid metadata is not needed for nearest-node prediction.
operations.known_value: one node converges to sample mean 0; average standardized distance sqrt(2/3)

operations.data: Numeric new feature rows with same width as saved model; 1..10000 rows.
args: Unchanged predict_parameters returned by self_organizing_map; <=16384 finite doubles.
operations.estimator: Nearest preprocessed codebook vector with fit-time origins, offsets and scales. No refitting on query rows. Exact distance ties select the lowest node index.
operations.prediction: Portable layout is shared with self_organizing_map; grid shape is unnecessary for nearest-node labels.
